outline:
先修課程：3001011或負責教授同意。
動力學基本原理: 力、質量與加速度、質點運動學、質點動力學、功與能、衝量與動量、剛體運動、剛體系的動力學。

鐵道內涵教學融合: 車輛動力方程, 輪軌耦合動力分析, 爬坡與打滑, 空氣動力, 鐵道車輛動力與阻力計算, 鐵道車輛剎車系統分析計算, 鐵道系統相關應用案例

Fundamentals of Dynamics: Force and Acceleration, Kinematics of a particle, Kinetics of a particle, Work and Energy, Impulse and Momentum, Kinematics of a Rigid Body, Kinetics of a Rigid Body.

Advance Topics: Vehicle Dynamics Equations, Wheel-Rail Coupling Dynamic Analysis, Climbing and Slippage, Aerodynamics, Railway Vehicle Dynamics and Resistance Calculations, Railway Vehicle Brake System Analysis and Calculations, Relevant Application Cases in Railway Systems
schedule:
1. Kinematics of a Particle
2. Kinetics of a Particle: Force and acceleration
3. Kinetics of a Particle: Work and Energy
4. Kinetics of a Particle: Impulse and Momentum
6. Kinematics of a Rigid Body
7. Kinetics of a Rigid Body: Force and acceleration
8. Kinetics of a Rigid Body: Work and Energy
9. Kinetics of a Rigid Body: Impulse and Momentum
assessment:
Exams (50%): Chapter Exam (50%)
Assignments and in class quiz (20%)
Projects (30%): competition score (15%), final report (8%), oral presentation (7%)
